literal_meaning: হালকা, ঝিরঝিরে শব্দ বা অনুভূতি প্রকাশকারী (onomatopoeic expression for light, rustling sensation)
example_sentences_in_english: Today my body feels quite fresh and light.
This breeze is light and refreshing.
note: Onomatopoeic idiom evoking a light, airy quality often used in natural contexts
